file(GLOB _sources
          IR/*.cpp
          Interfaces/*.cpp
          Canonicalize/*.cpp
          Transforms/*.cpp
          Transforms/ProcessorOptimize/*.cpp
    )

# TopOps.cpp is a template for mlir-src-sharder, not compiled directly.
# Sharded sources (TopOps.0.cpp .. TopOps.N.cpp) are generated by the shard
# rules in include/tpu_mlir/Dialect/Top/IR/CMakeLists.txt.
list(REMOVE_ITEM _sources "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/IR/TopOps.cpp")
set(TOP_OPS_SHARDED_SRCS "")
math(EXPR _last_shard "${TPUMLIR_OP_SHARD_COUNT} - 1")
foreach(index RANGE 0 ${_last_shard})
    list(APPEND TOP_OPS_SHARDED_SRCS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/tpu_mlir/Dialect/Top/IR/TopOps.${index}.cpp")
endforeach()
set_source_files_properties(${TOP_OPS_SHARDED_SRCS} PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE)
list(APPEND _sources ${TOP_OPS_SHARDED_SRCS})

add_mlir_library(TPUMLIRTop
  ${_sources}

  ADDITIONAL_HEADER_DIRS
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/tpu_mlir/Dialect/Top

  DEPENDS
  MLIRTopAttrGen
  MLIRTopOpsIncGen
  MLIRTopOpsShardGen
  MLIRTopPassIncGen
  MLIRInferenceInterfaceIncGen
  MLIRFlopsInterfaceIncGen
  MLIRShapeInterfaceIncGen

  LINK_LIBS PUBLIC
  MLIRIR
  MLIRPass
  MLIRSupport
  MLIRParser
  MLIRFuncDialect
  MLIRQuantDialect
  MLIRRewrite
  MLIRTransforms
  MLIRInferenceInterface
  MLIRFlopsInterface
  MLIRShapeInterface
  TPUMLIRSupport
  TPUMLIRTrait
)

if(TPUMLIR_USE_PCH)
    # add_mlir_library splits into obj.TPUMLIRTop (OBJECT lib, does compilation)
    # + TPUMLIRTop (link wrapper). PCH must target the OBJECT lib.
    if(TARGET obj.TPUMLIRTop)
        target_precompile_headers(obj.TPUMLIRTop PRIVATE ${TPUMLIR_PCH_HEADERS})
    else()
        target_precompile_headers(TPUMLIRTop PRIVATE ${TPUMLIR_PCH_HEADERS})
    endif()
endif()

# Exclude files with conflicting static function/class names from unity builds.
if(CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD)
  foreach(_file ${_sources})
    # ProcessorOptimize files — include Common.h with inline class definitions
    if(_file MATCHES "ProcessorOptimize/")
      set_source_files_properties(${_file} PROPERTIES SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION ON)
    endif()
    # StructOptimize — mlir::Value / llvm::json::Value name ambiguity
    if(_file MATCHES "Transforms/StructOptimize\\.cpp$")
      set_source_files_properties(${_file} PROPERTIES SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION ON)
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
